card.name: Inside necrotizing and precipitation terms
card.fires_on: The ending piece of the medical words necrotizing ("izing") and precipitation ("itation"), in warnings about fasciitis, enterocolitis or mixing drugs. Also fires on "fluorescence" in a lab test interference note.

modes.label: Necrotizing
modes.description: The "izing" ending of necrotizing before fasciitis or enterocolitis.
modes.example: Serious genitourinary infections, including urosepsis, pyelonephritis, and necrot<<izing>> fasciitis of the perineum

modes.label: Precipitation
modes.description: The "itation" ending of precipitation when discussing drugs mixing in solution.

modes.label: Fluorescence test
modes.description: The word fluorescence in a lab test interference note.
modes.example: False elevations of urinary catecholamines may occur due to interference with the<< fluorescence>> test.

card.writes: It seems to help finish the words precipitation and similar long word endings, with no clear wider effect.
card.plain: It lights up near the end of long words like necrotizing and precipitation in warnings.
